notes: ACCESS: plain requests fetch worked throughout - no WAF, no challenge, no proxy needed, same as the prior Home-Decor pass recorded in notes/100.md. robots.txt was checked first: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive; for User-agent * only /admin, /mon-compte, /recherche, /panier, /wishlist and filter query strings are disallowed, and /c/ category pages are explicitly allowed (only Pinterestbot is barred from /c/). TREE: taken from https://www.camif.fr/sitemap.categories.xml (355 category URLs), cross-checked against the homepage top nav (departments: Meubles, Canapes et fauteuils, Literie, Linge de maison, Deco, Arts de la table, Jardin, Enfant, Professionnels) and against the in-page sidebar nav rendered on each department and branch page. All 108 sitemap URLs under the four furniture-bearing branches (meubles, canapes-et-fauteuils, jardin, enfant) were fetched and parsed. The rendered nav exposed exactly one node the sitemap did not: /c/enfant/meubles-enfant/etageres-et-rangements - it redirects to its parent /c/enfant/meubles-enfant (final URL and rel=canonical both point at the parent, h1 'Meubles enfant', header 48 = the parent's own total), so it is not a real leaf and was dropped. QTY METHOD: every count is the site's own rendered French listing header 'N articles'. On every single-page category it was cross-checked twice over - against the product grid's data-product-count attribute and against the number of unique data-product-id tiles - and all three agreed on all 58 leaves. Page size is 46. Exhaustion was proven on the largest paginated node (Canapes droits): ?page=1..4 returned 46+46+15+0 = 107 unique tile ids, exactly the header, so the header is a true total and not a page size or display cap. The h1 of every leaf was checked against its slug (no silent parent-serving, the Magento-style trap), and every final URL equalled the requested URL (no redirects). DRIFT CHECK: two full reads were taken of all 58 leaves. 55 were byte-identical. Poufs and Repose-pieds swapped 3 products between the two reads (4/25 -> 7/22, sum constant at 29); third and fourth reads returned 7 and 22 stably, so those values were used and both rows carry a flag. URL DEPTH: only third-level leaves are emitted. Meubles (421), Canapes et fauteuils (261), Jardin (254), Enfant (58) and every second-level node are grouping rows with no qty. Sibling counts deliberately do NOT sum to their parent - Camif's sofa and bed sub-nodes are overlapping cuts of the same catalogue (a sofa is filed as both 'droit' and 'fixe'), so the children were emitted per the deepest-node rule and no parent number was ever derived from them. EXCLUDED, and why: the whole Literie department (matelas, sommiers incl. sommiers-coffre / tapissiers / electriques, surmatelas, couettes, oreillers, traversins, pieds-de-lits) - mattresses, bedding-filed bed bases and furniture parts; the real bed frames live under Meubles > Meubles de chambre > Lits and are included, so no furniture is lost. Linge de maison (all textiles), Deco (lighting, mirrors, wall decor, vases, candles, rugs) and Arts de la table (tableware and cookware) - other departments' scope. Meubles de bureau > Accessoires de bureau (21) - cable organisers, laptop and phone stands, desk trays, footrests: office supplies, not furniture. Enfant > Meubles enfant > Tiroirs et barrieres de lit (1) - the single SKU is a removable bed guard rail, a furniture part. Enfant > Literie enfant et bebe and Enfant > Linge enfant - mattresses and bed linen. Jardin > Salons de jardin > Coussins palettes et poufs (11) - outdoor seat cushions, pallet cushions and floor cushion-poufs, i.e. textiles (checked all product titles). Jardin > Transats > Accessoires transats (12) - replacement laces, cup-holder trays, parasol clips, seat cushions and throws. Jardin > Planchas et barbecues apart from Dessertes planchas (Planchas 19, Barbecues 1, Cuisines d'exterieur 13 - modular outdoor kitchens with sinks and fridges, Ensembles plancha + chariot 9, Accessoires 3) - appliances. Jardin > Jardinage (raised beds, composters, planters, water butts), Jardin > Equipement de jardin > Fontaines, and Jardin > Parasols et accessoires - garden equipment, planters and shade, not furniture. The entire /c/professionnels B2B branch (bureaux professionnels, sieges professionnels, tables professionnelles, rangements professionnels, canapes et fauteuils professionnels) was excluded: it is Camif's separate contract/B2B channel and the prior Home-Decor pass on this same company excluded it on exactly those grounds, so it is excluded here for cross-pass consistency. It is a clean, separately-URLed ~15-leaf furniture sub-tree if the orchestrator decides it belongs. Marketing, label and collection nodes were all dropped per the never-extract rule: /c/bois-massif, /c/fabrique-en-france, /c/fsc, /c/pefc, /c/oekotex, /c/coton, /c/lin, /c/chanvre, /c/meubles-eco-concus, /c/garantie-10-ans, every /c/selection-*, every /c/collection-*, every /c/notre-marque/marques-collections/*, /c/nouveautes, /c/destockage, /c/toutes-nos-promotions, /c/seconde-chance, /c/fin-de-serie and /c/art-de-recevoir. NAMING: all sub-category names are translated to plain-ASCII English with no French retained.
